subject.title: fix: channel setup succeeds when audit storage fails

question: Should a hosted channel setup that has already committed configuration return success when the subsequent system-agent audit append fails?
rationale: The code and sibling paths support best-effort auditing, but the protected label requires explicit human confirmation of the audit-durability contract for this user-facing setup flow.

options.title: Confirm best-effort audit
options.body: Accept success plus an operator-visible warning after a committed setup, matching the cited completed-operation audit paths.

options.title: Require durable audit
options.body: Keep setup fail-closed or design a compensating retry/outbox path if an audit entry is required before the operation may be reported successful.

recommendation.title: Confirm best-effort audit
recommendation.body: Accept success plus an operator-visible warning after a committed setup, matching the cited completed-operation audit paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the current implementation, runtime proof, and the relevant sibling-contract history for this system-agent path.
